fields.description: Hides the coupon code field from the cart in restaurant mode.
fields.label: Disable Coupon Code

fields.description: Hides the "More Options" section from the cart in restaurant mode.
fields.label: Disable More Options

fields.description: Hides the search box above the category (Item Group) list in the item grid while restaurant mode is on. Hidden by default — a restaurant menu usually has few enough categories that the box only takes up space.
fields.label: Hide Category Search

fields.description: Hides an Item Group from the category list when it has no item currently sellable in the POS — same rule as the item grid: disabled/non-sales items excluded, stock-out items excluded if "Hide Unavailable Items" is on for the POS Profile, and today's "plato del dia" picks applied for any gated groups. Off by default.
fields.label: Hide Empty Categories

fields.description: Shows the expected and sold amounts while closing the shift. Turn off for a blind count: the cashier enters what they actually counted without seeing what the till should hold. The difference is still recorded on the POS Closing Entry either way.
fields.label: Show Expected Amount When Closing

fields.description: How a combo's fixed price is split across its components. Proporcional: every component drops by the same percentage. Margen alto: components keep their list price and the slots marked with a Discount Order absorb the whole discount. Mixto: protected slots keep their list price and the rest is split proportionally among the absorbing ones. Each Restaurant Combo can override this.
fields.label: Default Combo Pricing Method

fields.description: Item Groups whose dishes must be explicitly enabled at shift-open time before they can be sold that day (e.g. Segundos, Sopas, Refrescos). Groups not listed here are always fully available, as before.
fields.label: Item Groups Requiring Daily Selection

fields.description: Print via a background job (needs an RQ worker running). Turn off only for dev benches with no worker — printing then happens inline and can add a few seconds to checkout.
fields.label: Print in Background

fields.description: If a printer is unreachable, complete the sale anyway and mark the ticket as Failed instead of blocking checkout.
fields.label: Never Block Checkout on a Printer Failure

fields.description: Prints the POS Invoice number at the top of the kitchen ticket.
fields.label: Show Order Number

fields.description: Prints the time the ticket was sent to the kitchen.
fields.label: Show Time

fields.description: Prints the customer's name under the header — useful for takeaway orders called out by name.
fields.label: Show Customer

fields.description: Prints each line's free modifiers (e.g. sin cebolla). Kitchen notes are always printed.
fields.label: Show Modifiers

fields.description: Print the till receipt to any configured Recibo (Caja) Restaurant Printer as soon as a sale completes. Uses the same background-job / never-block-checkout settings as the Kitchen Ticket above.
fields.label: Print Receipt on Payment

fields.description: Prints the invoice number and the date/time under the company name.
fields.label: Show Invoice Number and Date

fields.description: Prints the customer's name (walk-in customers are never printed).
fields.label: Show Customer

fields.description: Prints the tax breakdown line by line before the total. The total itself is always printed.
fields.label: Show Tax Breakdown

fields.description: Prints the payment modes with their amounts and the change given.
fields.label: Show Payments and Change
